objective: Implement and prove the smallest native persistent supervision solution appropriate to macOS for Mac Chief heartbeat and result monitor.

concrete_specifications.supervisor_mechanism: launchd LaunchAgent plist (~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.symphony.mac_chief.plist) or persistent supervisor script with respawn loop
concrete_specifications.heartbeat_payload_fix: Dynamically evaluate datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() inside the 15s pulse loop (do not reuse static payload dictionary instantiated at boot)
verification_requirements: Heartbeat resumes automatically on process exit or reboot
Zero duplicate ACKs and zero duplicate effects
Quiescent wakeability when queue is empty
